channel.title: Ledgize Guides
channel.description: Plain-English guides for Shopify, Amazon and eBay sellers.

item.title: Your Shopify deposit isn't your revenue. Here's what's inside it.
item.description: A Shopify Payments payout mixes sales, shipping, sales tax, refunds and fees into one number. Here's how to split it so your books show what you really earned.

item.title: Why your Amazon sales land in the wrong month
item.description: Amazon pays out in settlements that don't follow the calendar, so a single deposit can hold sales from two months. Here's how that skews your monthly numbers, and how to fix it.

item.title: Profitable on paper, short on cash: where the money went
item.description: Your profit and loss says you made money, but your bank balance went down. Here are the usual reasons for e-commerce sellers, and the one report that shows them.
